sections.description: FSE Dental Clinic is a modern, elegant, and fully customizable free theme designed for dental clinics, dentists, dental surgeons, orthodontists, pediatric dentists, cosmetic dentistry clinics, oral care professionals, oral hygiene centers, dental hospitals, healthcare service providers, and best dentist websites. Built with Full Site Editing (FSE) functionality, it lets you easily customize headers, footers, templates, and blocks using a smooth drag-and-drop interface to create a professional dental website. This FSE Dental Clinic theme helps showcase dental care services, teeth whitening, dental implants, braces, root canal treatment, oral surgery, smile makeover services, and patient-focused healthcare content with a clean and trustworthy design. It is fully responsive, mobile-friendly, and optimized for fast loading and search engine visibility, helping dental practices rank better and attract local patients online. The theme supports WooCommerce for selling dental products, oral hygiene kits, or managing online payments, and integrates seamlessly with Contact Form 7 for appointment booking, dental consultations, and patient inquiries. With easy customization options for typography, colors, layouts, and page sections, this full site editing dental theme includes ready-made areas for services, testimonials, dentist profiles, before-and-after treatment galleries, and appointment scheduling. Ideal for dental clinics, cosmetic dentistry practices, oral health consultants, and medical care websites, the FSE Dental Clinic theme combines SEO-friendly structure, lightweight coding, and modern design to build a high-performing dental website that creates trust and leaves a strong first impression. Demo Link - https://pattern.cretathemes.com/fse-dental-clinic/
